experiment_suite: TCD v15.0 Reproducible Numerical Audit Experiments
scientific_disclaimer: Diagnostic and audit calculations only. No physical validation of Thermo-Chromo-Dynamics is claimed.

exp1_spectral_dimension.formula: d_S(T) = 2 + 2 / [1 + (T / T*)^kappa] with T* = 1.22e19 GeV, kappa = 0.7

exp3_polyakov_cf.indexing_and_range: 31 temperature points T=0..300 MeV in 10 MeV steps (index 0..30); width sweep w in [5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 50] MeV

analytical_derivatives.dL_dT: dL/dT = (1/w) * L * (1 - L) > 0 for all T

untuned_domain_reach_analysis.conclusion: At default Lambda_QCD = 217 MeV and P <= 1, reaching Tc = 156.5 MeV requires CF = 1.3866 > 1.0 (unphysical). At CF = 0.738, reaching 156.5 MeV requires P = 0.2831 (N_eff = 0.212). Under the standard domain CF <= 1.0 and P <= 1.0, 156.5 MeV is ONLY reachable if Lambda_QCD <= 156.5 MeV.

candidate_1_dimensional.unit_note: Lambda_cand has units GeV^2; rho_DE has units GeV^4

exp6_thermal_delta_g.formula: DeltaG/G = (T / M_GUT)^2 * (N_hidden / N_spin10) with M_GUT=1.03e16 GeV, N_hidden=125, N_spin10=45
key_observations: At today (2.35e-13 GeV), evaluated DeltaG/G = 1.45e-57 (25 orders of magnitude below claimed 1e-32).
At BBN (1 MeV), evaluated DeltaG/G = 2.62e-38 (36 orders of magnitude below claimed 1e-2).
The ansatz behaves purely as a tiny high-temperature expansion term, vanishing rapidly at low temperatures.

calibration_diagnostic.note: Calibration diagnostic only — target alpha_s is imported from experiment, not predicted.
